_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoked: Done: Get a company's contact details from its website
_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Get a company's contact details from its website...

description: Get the contact details a business publishes on its own website: we read its home page and up to three contact, about or imprint pages that its robots.txt allows, and return its role mailboxes (info@, sales@, support@ and the like) on the site's own domain, phone numbers from tel: links, its company social profiles (LinkedIn company page, X, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, GitHub, TikTok) and the name, address, phone and email in its schema.org data, each with the page it came from. A named person's mailbox, an address at another domain and a personal profile are left out (named_emails_left_out counts the mailboxes). A site whose robots.txt disallows us is not read. Costs 1 credit. Every row has name (platform/collection/id), kind, its fields and source {platform, url, license, attribution, fetched_at, terms_url}; quote source.attribution when you show a row.

domain.description: The company's website, such as stripe.com (a URL also works).

name: data_website_contacts
title: Get a company's contact details from its website
